comment: Screenshot shot list for VICE COVER STUDIO. The capture script reads this file, serves the app with serve.ts, applies each named state through window.__viceStudio.applyShot(name), waits for fonts and images, then saves a JPEG capture sharpened with the house unsharp finish. Shot 1 is the judged cover.
